messages:
maya: Quick Q — thinking about adding a 'variant warmup' step in the Console experiment create flow. Idea: ramp traffic to a new variant slowly over X mins to populate caches/KV and collect telemetry before full rollout. Thoughts?

sam: +1. Need API and UI. API: add warmup_window + warmup_traffic fields to experiment create. UI: make it an optional accordion. Keep defaults conservative.

jordan: Concern: quotas. If warmup consumes quota we might exceed customer's reserved cap. Should be able to pin warmup to 'system' budget or have a dedicated warmup allowance.

eli: Telemetry hook: tag warmup requests with metadata {phase: "warmup"} so metrics/alerts can filter them out of steady-state KPIs. Also note cache priming may not reflect real user behavior — call that out in docs.

frankie: UX: show a progress bar and expected token estimate for warmup. Also allow cancellation and a little explainer copy: "Warmup primes model caches & collects quality signals."

deploy-bot: experiment-service v1.42 deployed to staging :white_check_mark:

maya: Good call on tagging. Sam — can we reuse existing routing rule DSL? e.g.

```
route: {
  default_variant: "A",
  variants: [
    {name: "B", weight: 0.01, warmup: {duration_mins: 30, target_pct: 10}}
  ]
}
```

sam: Yeah that's fine but we need guardrails: max warmup_duration = 1440 (24h), max target_pct = 25 for free tiers. Server-side enforcement required to avoid accidental huge warmups.

jordan: Also add a quota-affecting flag: "charge_during_warmup" default true, but allow tenants with reserved capacity to set false so warmup doesn't count vs commit. Need billing input.

product-anna: Note — collecting extra telemetry during warmup is fine if opt-in. Need privacy/terms check and an obvious toggle in the UI.

eli: One more: fallback behavior if variant fails during warmup — auto-roll back to baseline and page on-call. Add circuit-breaker hook: failure_rate > threshold => pause traffic and roll back.

frankie: I'll sketch UI microcopy and a small mock. Will drop in #design in a bit.

maya: Thanks all. Action items: sam to sketch API changes, eli to add telemetry tags + metrics filters, jordan to validate quota/billing interactions, frankie to produce UI mock, product-anna to confirm opt-in wording. Ping me when PRs exist. :thumbsup:
